content: The passing away of Cohen-Tannoudji brought to my attention that PhysLib is lacking a k-space representation of Maxwell's equations. I think stating the k-space equations as 4 lemmas is a good contribution?

Yeah - I think this would be very good! We are working on updating the foundations of Maxwell's equations, but in any case; having these in now, would be good - we can move them to the new foundations at some point in the future.
Could you point out which discussion thread covers the update you're doing? I think I missed it
Hi @Shlok Vaibhav, this thread might be what you're looking for: #Physlib > Electromagnetism

Thanks! I read the discussion, I believe the global Fourier domain representation will still be needed for many results, and I will try to go ahead with it. The long indian vacation season has started.
